appSubtitle: Convert ornitho exports into eBird checklists
ebirdLanguageHelp: Used to match ornitho species names to your eBird language.
autoAssignDurationHelp: Maximum time gap in hours used to automatically group same-day sightings into checklists. The default is 24 hours.
distanceHelp: Maximum distance in kilometers used to automatically group same-day sightings into checklists.
partySizeHelp: Default number of observers for newly created checklists.
advancedModeSimpleBody: After import, the app automatically groups same-day sightings into checklists using your aggregation duration, aggregation distance and default party size. Any additional metadata changes are then made in eBird after import.
advancedModeCustomBody: After the same automatic grouping, the app also opens an in-app checklist review so you can inspect grouped checklists, adjust metadata and comments, and choose what to export before importing into eBird.
mapboxTokenHelp: Use a public Mapbox token with the styles:tiles scope if you want static map generation.
staticMapEnabled: Include static map in checklist comment
staticMapHelp: Add a static map image to the checklist comment. When enabled, the settings below define how that image is generated.
githubTokenHelp: Use a GitHub token with gist scope if you want to publish checklist geometry as an interactive map later.
infoDescription: Ornitho2eBird converts exports from ornitho websites, Observation websites and BirdLasser into eBird-ready checklists.
infoHowItWorksIntro: In the default mode, the app is designed to work automatically after import, without using Advanced options.
infoHowItWorksPointOne: Imported forms are kept as checklists when the source file already contains checklist-level data.
infoHowItWorksPointTwo: Individual sightings without a checklist are grouped automatically by day, time gap and distance using your current settings.
infoHowItWorksPointThree: The exported CSV uses the grouped checklists directly, so Advanced mode is only needed when you want to review or adjust details manually.
infoAutoAssignIntro: Automatic assignment only applies to sightings that do not already belong to an imported checklist.
infoAutoAssignPointOne: The default behavior sorts incidental sightings by date, time, then coordinates before grouping them.
infoAutoAssignPointTwo: A sighting can join an existing checklist only if it is on the same calendar day and within both the aggregation duration and aggregation distance.
infoAutoAssignPointThree: The comparison is made against any already-assigned sighting in that checklist, not against the checklist center.
infoAutoAssignPointFour: The grouping is transitive: if A matches B and B matches C, all three can end up in the same checklist.
infoAutoAssignPointFive: If no time is available, the sighting is treated as 00:00. With the default 24 hour duration, same-day sightings are therefore grouped mainly by distance.
infoAutoAssignPointSix: If several sightings share the exact same location, their spatial distance is 0 km, so they group together whenever the day and duration rule also match.
introWorkflowImport: Export your data from the source website and load the file here.
introWorkflowAdvanced: Advanced mode lets you review or adjust checklist metadata before export.
introWorkflowExport: Download the eBird Record Format CSV and upload it in the eBird import tool.
introWorkflowReview: After import, review checklist locations, hotspot matches and species names in eBird.
prerequisiteLabel: Before continuing, confirm that you understand:
importantRuleOne: Mapping protocols from ornitho, BirdLasser or Observation to eBird is not always exact. Complete stationary or traveling checklists are preferred when you can provide effort details.
importantRuleTwo: Keeping a link to the original sighting in species comments can help eBird reviewers validate records.
importantRuleThree: For pre-eBird life list imports that do not meet current eBird checklist rules, consolidate data carefully and review the import afterward.
formsAndSightings: Data loaded successfully: {forms} forms and {sightings} incidental sightings
importHelpOrnitho: Open the export page, choose Recent days or Date range, export the results as JSON, then import that JSON file here.
importHelpObservation: Open the Observations page, export your records as CSV, then import that CSV file here.
importHelpBirdlasser: Export your records from BirdLasser as CSV, then import that CSV file here.
importHelpOrnithoNet: Open 'All my sightings', keep the website in English, export the results as TXT, then import that TXT file here.
websiteWarning: The first record does not seem to match {website}. First location detected: {location}.
taxonomicIssueBody: Some species could not be matched to the selected eBird language. The CSV can still be exported, but you may need to fix species names during eBird import.
speciesCodePrompt: Enter the matching eBird species code
advancedIntro: Automatic grouping is already applied. Use this section to review each checklist, adjust metadata, draw a path when needed, and choose what to export before importing into eBird.
assignmentIntro: Use the map to create checklists or reassign incidental sightings between checklists before export. A sighting joins a checklist when it is on the same calendar day and within both the duration and distance thresholds of at least one sighting already in that checklist.
assignmentWarning: Sightings under "0. Non-assigned" will not be exported.
assignResetConfirm: Are you sure you want to reset checklist assignment? This cannot be undone.
assignDurationLongConfirm: The selected duration is longer than recommended. Do you want to continue anyway?
assignDurationTooLong: The selected duration is too long.
assignDistanceLongConfirm: The selected distance is longer than recommended. Do you want to continue anyway?
assignDistanceTooLong: The selected distance is too long.
assignNoSightings: There are no non-assigned sightings left to assign.
assignNoSightingsInSelection: No sightings were found inside the selected rectangle. Draw the selection over sightings and try again.
warningMultipleDays: This checklist contains sightings from different days and should be split before export.
warningInvalid: This checklist is invalid for export. A date is required and duration must stay below one day.
speciesCommentTemplateHelp: You can edit the species comment template using the HTML/JS code below. Use the notation ${ javascript code } to display dynamic information on each species. You can acess the variable at the species level using ${ s.property } where the properties are listed on the table on the right.
longTemplateHelp: You can use a secondary species comment template when more than the threshold number of sightings of the same species are recorded.
multipleSightingsBody: When a species is recorded multiple time, we add the count and join the comments in a new line.
multipleSightingsLimitText: With the current template, you can expect to exceed eBird's limit of characters (8000) with around {count} sightings of the same species.
applyObserversToEmpty: Apply observer count to empty checklists
applyObserversNone: No other checklists have an empty observer count.
applyObserversConfirm: Apply observer count {value} to {count} checklist(s) with no observer count?
updatePathConfirm: Update the checklist path and set distance to {next} km?
updatePathConfirmReplace: Replace the current path distance of {previous} km with the new path distance of {next} km?
notReady: No checklist is currently ready for export.
exportReady: {ready} of {total} checklists are ready. Download the CSV and upload it to the eBird import tool.
exportErrors: Some records cannot be exported yet. The most common issue is a species comment that exceeds eBird limits.
finalSteps: After importing, review your checklist text and species names in eBird. If the import is wrong, delete it and upload a corrected CSV.
